title: Beyond Beats
author: OXT-Beyond contributors
description: A beat studio in the browser. Lay down drums in the channel rack, write bass lines and chords in the piano roll, arrange patterns into a song in the playlist, and mix it with reverb, delay and a fader for every channel. Sixteen drums and five synths are made by the browser as it plays, and you can load samples of your own. Save your song as a file and export it as a WAV.
